improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

Using the WebPilot AI assistant, construct a detailed and comprehensive outline for a 2,000-word article titled "Uncovering the Best SEO Prompts for Your Content Strategy." The outline should be based on an in-depth analysis of the top 10 search engine results for the keyword 'best SEO prompts' on Google.

Your outline should include every relevant heading possible, ensuring a high keyword density while maintaining coherence. Organize the outline into two parts for optimal reader navigation: Part 1 and Part 2.

For each section of the outline, clearly specify the desired word count. This will serve as a detailed blueprint for the article, allowing for the creation of a 2,000-word piece with ease.

In addition to the main body of the article, the outline must include a comprehensive FAQ section. This section should be based on the 'People also ask' section from Google for the keyword 'best SEO prompts.' Address at least 10-15 frequently asked questions to provide thorough coverage.

Furthermore, generate an extensive list of LSI (Latent Semantic Indexing) keywords and NLP (Natural Language Processing) keywords related to 'best SEO prompts.' Include any other relevant keywords that could enhance the article's SEO value and semantic richness. Aim for a minimum of 50 keywords.

Lastly, provide a list of 3 relevant external links that should be included in the article. Ensure these links are not directly competing with your article and provide significant value to the readers. Clearly specify the recommended anchor text for each link to maintain a natural and SEO-friendly link profile.

Remember to maintain a neutral and informative tone throughout the outline, as the final article will be aimed at a knowledgeable audience seeking authoritative guidance on the best SEO prompts for content creation and optimization. Focus on providing actionable insights and expert recommendations.

Please format the outline using clear headings for each section, sub-section, and the FAQ section. Use bullet points or numbered lists for the keyword lists and external links for easy reference. The final outline should be a polished, professional, and user-friendly resource that sets a high standard for the SEO community.

Ensure the outline is submitted in a clean, readable format, ready to be translated into a high-quality, 2,000-word article.
